name: Monster: Chronicles of Blood
summary:
The night awaits you in Puerto Umbrío. In Monster: Chronicles of Blood, every day is an opportunity to decide what kind of vampire you want to be. Start as a neophyte who barely knows their powers, or choose a more experienced origin, all the way up to embodying an Ancestor with over three millennia of memories. Your chronicle is built on decisions, relationships, and a city that changes over time.

Explore the city through an interactive map, locations, and action panels. Investigate, converse, work, study, and earn money to build your life in Puerto Umbrío. Four factions each have their own reputations and benefits. Their conflicts allow you to investigate, support one side, attempt mediation, or stay out of it. The stories present choices with costs and consequences: what you decide shapes your relationships and your character’s opportunities.
